subject: Auditing and Ethics
question_text:
7.
Which actions should the Ravi & Mehta engagement partner take as per
compliance with professional ethical requirements and independent
principles?
(i)  Obtain information from the firm to identify and evaluate the threats.
(ii)  Evaluate whether the action create threats to independence.
(iii)  Apply safeguards or eliminate threats to an acceptable level.
(iv)  Report the issue directly to the client's CSR Committee for their
resolution.
(v)  Consider withdrawal from the engagement if threats remain
unacceptable.
(A)  (i), (ii) and (iii) only
(B)  (i), (ii) (iii) and (v)
(C)  (ii), (iii) and (v) only
(D) (i), (iv) and (v) only
(2 Marks)
